dialogue.content: おはようございますよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.content: (おはようございます。まだカウンセラー役の経験が少なく不慣れなためご迷惑をおかけすると思いますがよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたらはじめさせていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (Good morning. I'm still new to the role of a counselor and inexperienced, so I apologize for any trouble this may cause, but I look forward to working with you. We'll begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですよ😊
dialogue.English: That's totally fine. 😊

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございます😊たくさん学ばせていただきたいと思います。よろしくお願いします！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you. 😊 I hope to learn a lot from this. Thank you for your cooperation!)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。今日はご相談に来てくださって、ありがとうございます。はじめに、年齢と性別、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 52歳、男性、娘の不登校に関する相談です
dialogue.English: I'm a 52-year-old man, and I'd like to discuss my daughter's school refusal.

dialogue.content: お答えいただきありがとうございます。娘さんが不登校なのですね。それはおつらいですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. So, your daughter is refusing to go to school. That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ‥高2の娘なのですが、高1の終わり頃から学校に行けなくなってしまって
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right... She's a sophomore in high school, but she hasn't been able to go to school since around the end of her freshman year.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。学校に行けなくなると心配になりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. It’s understandable to be worried when she's unable to go to school.

dialogue.content: ええ出席日数がそろそろ限界にきてしまいました最初はかなり行くように説得してみたのですが
dialogue.English: Yes, her number of attendance days is getting dangerously low. At first, I tried hard to persuade her to go.

dialogue.content: そうですか。娘さんとお話をする機会も設けたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you've created opportunities to talk with your daughter, then.

dialogue.content: 出席日数も関係してくると、色々考えてしまいますね。
dialogue.English: With her attendance being a factor, I'm sure you have a lot on your mind.

dialogue.content: そうですね学校に行く話をすると部屋に閉じこもってしまって
dialogue.English: That's right. Whenever I bring up going to school, she shuts herself in her room.

dialogue.content: このままでは留年です
dialogue.English: At this rate, she’ll have to repeat the year.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。留年となると心配ですね。娘さんには説得したいのだけれど、お話しできていないということですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. The possibility of her having to repeat a year is concerning. Is it that you want to persuade her, but you haven’t been able to really talk with her about it?

dialogue.content: はいたまに話ができても本人は学校に行くと言うばかりで
dialogue.English: Yes. Even when we do manage to talk occasionally, she just keeps saying she’ll go to school.

dialogue.content: ええ、学校に行くと言うものの実際は行動できていないという状況でしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see—so although she says she’ll go, she isn’t able to follow through with it?

dialogue.content: 一応行こうとすることはあるのですが行けそうにないのです電車で学校に行くのですが、途中でお腹が痛くなったり、気分が悪くなったりするので
dialogue.English: She does try to go sometimes, but she doesn't seem able to make it. She takes the train to school, but along the way she gets stomachaches or feels sick.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。娘さんも頑張って学校に行こうとしても、体調が悪くなると心配になりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be worrying that your daughter tries so hard to go to school, only to end up feeling unwell.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ心療内科にも行って薬をもらったのですがやっぱりだめで
dialogue.English: Exactly. We even went to a psychosomatic clinic where she was prescribed medication, but it still hasn’t helped.

dialogue.content: もう無理なんじゃないかと思います
dialogue.English: I’m starting to think it might be impossible for her now.

dialogue.content: 病院にも行かれたのですね。学校に行けない状況では、そのようなお気持ちになるのも、無理のない事だと感じますよ。
dialogue.English: So you've even been to a clinic. Given the situation, it's completely understandable that you feel that way.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: もう転校を考えるしかないですかね？
dialogue.English: Do you think transferring schools is the only option left?

dialogue.content: 転校も考えられているのですね。娘さんのことを想う気持ちがとても伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: So you're considering a transfer as well. I can really feel how much you care for your daughter.

dialogue.content: 留年はさせたくないので、通信の学校への転校を考えたほうがいいと思うのですでもその話もなかなかできなくて
dialogue.English: I don’t want her to have to repeat a year, so I think we should consider transferring her to a correspondence school, but it’s hard to even bring up the subject with her.

dialogue.content: そうですね。留年はさせたくないのですね。通信の学校の話をということですが、娘さんとは他にもどの様なお話をされたいと思っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. You don't want her to have to repeat the year. You mentioned talking about a correspondence school, but what other things would you like to discuss with your daughter?

dialogue.content: 学校に行けると思っているのか、本音を聞きたいですね
dialogue.English: I'd like to hear her true feelings—whether she really thinks she can go back to school.

dialogue.content: 学校が合わないようなことは言っていたので
dialogue.English: She has mentioned before that the school isn't a good fit for her.

dialogue.content: 教えたいただきありがとうございます。学校が合わないというお話をされたことがあるのですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me. So, she has mentioned that the school isn't a good fit for her.

dialogue.content: 本音を聞きたいとのことですが、この相談では娘さんとどうすればお話ができるか考える、ということでいいですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned wanting to hear her true feelings. For this session, would it be helpful if we focus on how you might be able to have that conversation with your daughter?

dialogue.content: そうですねそれも一つですあと何か学校に行ける方法があるのかとか
dialogue.English: Yes, that's one thing. And also, whether there are any ways she might be able to manage to go to school.

dialogue.content: まずは娘と話ですかね‥
dialogue.English: I suppose talking with my daughter comes first...

dialogue.content: そうですね。お話しすることがまず第一歩と私は考えたのですが、あなたは今この状況を変えたいと一番思うのはどういうことですか？
dialogue.English: I agree. I think talking with her is the first step. But what is the one thing you most want to change about this situation right now?

dialogue.content: 留年はさせたくないということです
dialogue.English: I don't want her to have to repeat the year.

dialogue.content: まあそれより娘に元気になってほしいですね
dialogue.English: Well, more than that, I just want my daughter to get better.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。娘さんにまず元気になってほしいというお気持ち、とても愛情を感じます。
dialogue.English: I see. Your desire for your daughter to get better, first and foremost, truly shows how much love you have for her.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます元気になってもらうためにはどうすればいいですかね？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What can I do to help her get better?

dialogue.content: そうですね。まずはあなたのお気持ちを何かしらの方法で伝えるのがよいと私は思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Well, I think a good first step would be to find a way to convey your feelings to her. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: 私にできることというのはそれが一番かもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: That might be the best thing I can do.

dialogue.content: 話を聴いてあげることできますかね最初にきつく言い過ぎてしまったので
dialogue.English: I wonder if I can just listen to her, though. I was too harsh with her at the beginning.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。これだけ愛情深いあなたのお気持ちは娘さんに伝わると思います。そしてきっとお話をすることができると思います。
dialogue.English: I see. With such deep affection, I believe your feelings will get through to your daughter. And I'm sure you will be able to have that conversation.

dialogue.content: そうですね話ができるような雰囲気づくり頑張ってみましょうかねちょっと考えてみます
dialogue.English: You're right. Maybe I'll try to create an atmosphere where we can talk. I'll think about it for a bit.

dialogue.content: そうですね。何かお話できる方法など今思い浮かびますか？
dialogue.English: That's a good idea. Do any ways you could talk with her come to mind right now?

dialogue.content: 最初にきつく言い過ぎたことを謝ってから話を聴いてあげる雰囲気をつくってみます
dialogue.English: I’ll start by apologizing for having been too harsh, and then I'll try to create an atmosphere where I can listen to her.

dialogue.content: ええ、最初に言い過ぎた事を伝えると、娘さんもお話しやすくなると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think letting her know that you feel you were too harsh at first will make it easier for her to talk.

dialogue.content: そうですね一度それでやってみますうまくいかなかったらまた相談させてください
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll give that a try. If it doesn't go well, may I schedule another consultation with you?

dialogue.content: そうですね。娘さんが好きな飲み物を飲みながらとか、外出できるようなら静かなカフェに出かけるなど、落ち着いてお話できるかなと思ったのですが、もしよければ参考にしてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Of course. I was just thinking that perhaps you could talk calmly over her favorite drink, or if she's able to go out, at a quiet cafe. Please feel free to use these as suggestions if you'd like.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間が近づいてきました。ここまでお話ししてきましたがいかがだったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up. How do you feel about what we've discussed today?

dialogue.content: 娘と話ができるように頑張ってみますありがとうございます
dialogue.English: I’ll do my best to talk with my daughter. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今はまだすぐに大きく前進ということは難しいかもしれないですが、こんなに真剣に考えてくれるお父さんを持つ娘さんは、きっとこれからも愛情を感じながら一歩づつでも前を向いて進んでいけるのではないかと思います。まずはお話してみて、また相談にいらっしゃってくださいね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. It may be difficult to make big strides right away, but with a father who cares as deeply as you do, I believe your daughter will continue to feel your love and be able to move forward, one step at a time. Please try talking with her first, and feel free to come back for another consultation anytime.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。本日はこれで相談を終了したいと思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. We’ll conclude our session here for today.

dialogue.content: では、お時間になりましたので終了のメッセージを送ります。
dialogue.English: It’s time now, so I will send the closing message.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますお疲れさまでした
dialogue.English: Thank you. You've been a great help.

dialogue.content: （こちらこそ、ありがとうございました！たくさんアドバイスいただけたらと思います。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you, as well! I'd appreciate any advice you have for me.)

dialogue.content: お疲れさまでした
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.
